note: Partial, PRECISION-focused manifest. BlazingMQ has no public CVE. The one publicly documented fuzz finding (an assertion crash in Event::initialize) is UNREACHABLE in production due to the framing layer, so it is labeled known_safe: a high-quality audit must NOT report it as an exploitable vulnerability. This manifest therefore measures false-positive elimination (reachability gate) on a real target. Add confirmed true-positives here if/when advisories are published.

ground_truth.label: known_safe
ground_truth.notes: Fuzz test found an input that fails the assertion in safe/debug builds, but bmqio::ChannelUtil::handleRead frames incoming packets to the declared length BEFORE they reach bmqp::Event, guaranteeing the invariant in production. Not reachable by an attacker -> must NOT be reported as exploitable (reachability gate must reject).
